candidate_name: Aruba LNG Terminal (Eagle LNG / WEB) — viability watch
sponsor_or_proposer: Eagle LNG Partners Jacksonville LLC; Water- en Energiebedrijf Aruba NV (WEB)
current_state: Already in GEM as 'proposed' (T100000131116). No forward progress since ~2023; planned 2024 start missed by 2 years. 2025-11-08 Aruba/NL decision to dismantle the San Nicolas (former Lago/RdA) refinery site casts doubt on the proposal, though no announcement names the LNG terminal.
missing_threshold_elements: Confirmation the project is alive vs. cancelled by the San Nicolas redevelopment; any FID/permit/capacity/start-date update post-2023.
watch_for: WEB Aruba or Aruba govt statement on LNG-to-power post-refinery-dismantling; Eagle LNG re-publishing or formally dropping the Aruba project; San Nicolas redevelopment master plan and whether it includes an LNG regas terminal.
notes: Not a new-terminal candidate (already in GEM); this is a cancellation/shelving watch for the existing record. best_lead_url is the Aruba government announcement of the former-Lago/RdA refinery dismantling (gobierno.aw, non-GEM, url_verifier PASS on 'refinery'); LNG Prime article documents the Eagle LNG Aruba facility plan and its stall (non-GEM, PASS on 'plans'). No gem.wiki sources used.
